purpose: Determine whether current Stage 6 live regime is consistent with the stock's verified historical behavioural profile. This is an eligibility gate only; it is not a trade signal or authorization.

inputs.live_regimes: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output

research_basis.step6: Verified walk-forward OOS trend-event, strong-trend, and event-return evidence.
research_basis.step7: Historical OHLCV liquidity proxy only; not live order-book depth.

cross_stock_reference.method: Median of the 29 locked Stage 5 research profiles

activation_rules.BULLISH_BREAKOUT_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock OR-continuation rate >= 0.375; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.BEARISH_BREAKDOWN_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock OR-continuation rate >= 0.375; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.BULLISH_ALIGNMENT_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock trend rate >= 0.2875; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.BEARISH_ALIGNMENT_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock trend rate >= 0.2875; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.BULLISH_WEAK_ALIGNMENT_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock trend rate >= 0.2875; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.BEARISH_WEAK_ALIGNMENT_REGIME: EDGE_ACTIVE when stock trend rate >= 0.2875; otherwise EDGE_INACTIVE.
activation_rules.NEUTRAL_MIXED_REGIME: EDGE_INACTIVE because no directional live regime is present.

provenance_rules: Every result must identify the Stage 5 profile source and profile version.
Historical rates are priors/eligibility evidence, not current-session probabilities.
No direction is inferred from historical data alone; direction comes only from Stage 6 live regime classification.
No live result may add, remove, or reorder the canonical 29.
Missing profile, missing regime, stale data, invalid data, or universe mismatch must fail closed.
Stage 2–8 research logic is immutable under Stage 7.
